messages:
Nora: Heads-up 9— CascadeBio QBR on Thursday. Their pipeline mixes retrieval + heavy rerank + embeddings. We saw a sudden 2x embed spike yesterday. Need: one clean forecast slide, a short set of customer-facing options (low-lift to buy runway), and alert wording for the renewal owner.

Samir: On it. Pulling 7/30/90d deltas now. Quick Q: do we show both unit-economics and projected seat-level cost? The buyer will ask about per-user cost.

billing-bot: NOTICE: cascadebio consumed 72% of monthly retainer. Thresholds currently: 70/85/95. Current period usage: 72%.

Pete: Recommend presenting three mitigations (order of friction): 1) quick cache + dedup for retrieval layer (minutes), 2) per-route throttles for non-critical reranks (config), 3) short runway buffer (one-time credit + optional 2-week reduced commit).

Anya: I can draft an enablement offer: 45-min tuning session + code patch for dedup + a one-off "runway buffer" credit up to $1.5k. If they accept the buffer, we schedule the tuning within 5 business days.

Samir: Numbers pasted: ```
7d avg tokens/day: 1,400,000
30d avg tokens/day: 930,000
90d avg tokens/day: 610,000
Embed ops/day: 26,800
Retainer: $18,500/month
Projected 30d spend (status quo): $22,900
Projected 30d spend (with dedup+cache): $17,900
Projected 30d spend (with dedup+cache+route-throttle): $15,800
Days to retainer exhaustion (status quo): 9
``` Link: https://redwood.app/sheets/cascadebio-qbr (sheet has a runsheet tab).

Nora: Nice. For the QBR, we need: single-slide problem statement, cost delta table (3 rows for the scenarios above), and customer-friendly text for the renewal owner.

Pete: Suggested alert language: 70% = "Heads-up: CascadeBio has used 70% of monthly credits." 85% = "Action recommended: usage at 85%. Recommend booking a 45-min tuning session to avoid interruption." 95% = "Critical: usage at 95%. System will propose a one-time buffer credit or a short commit to maintain service." Keep it punchy.

Anya: Workshop plan (45m): 5m intake, 20m hands-on dedup/cache tune, 15m route throttle + rollout checklist, 5m next steps. Deliverable: playbook + sample patch. Dedup snippet: ```
retrieval.dedup.enabled = true
retrieval.dedup.similarity_threshold = 0.88
retrieval.batch.size = 256
```
Cache snippet: ```
kv_cache.enabled = true
kv_cache.max_prefix_tokens = 2048
kv_cache.eviction_policy = "lru"
```

Samir: I'll add per-user cost calc to the forecast sheet (net cost per active scientist) and run a micro-commit ROI slide: commit = $3k top-up at 10% discount vs expected overage.

eng-bot: NOTE: quick quantization test (fp16->int8) reduces gen token cost by ~12% in canary runs; may affect latency on CPU fallbacks. Recommend A/B test.

Nora: Good point. Add a footnote: quantization gains may vary; recommend measuring quality on a 5% traffic slice. We'll propose the A/B in the playbook.

Pete: Owners: Samir -> update forecast sheet + add per-user calc; Anya -> workshop slides + one-pager + buffer credit wording; Pete -> craft the renewal talking points and alert copy; Nora -> consolidate QBR deck and lead the renewal ask. I'll block a 30-min dry run Wed 16:00.

Samir: Confirmed 99I'll push the updated numbers and a small chart (7d vs 30d burn) by EOD.

billing-bot: REMINDER: cascadebio will hit 80% threshold in approx 4 days at current run-rate.

Nora: Thanks team. Goal: show the customer three clear paths to avoid an expensive overage and give renewal owner a low-friction option to keep them online. Will circulate the deck draft after Samir pushes the chart. :white_check_mark:
